task: ae.merkle: 16-ary hash-trie Merkle map with inclusion/non-inclusion proofs and verified anti-entropy sync
reasoning_summary: Content-only Merkle trie (depth 4, fanout 16 over SHA-256 of the key) with cached hashes and pruning, strict proof verification, and top-down sync that verifies every remote reply against the hash its parent advertised. Verified by an independent recursive oracle after every random step, per-byte proof tamper loops, honest and misfiled hostile remotes, and a 30-mutant check (2 equivalent survivors justified).
